steps.content: You traverse the Drifter Camp, clearing the monsters near the ruins. According to Yanyan, this should count as helping clean up around the blessed tree.
Yanyan points at the ruins of the High Tower, flipping open a book to read aloud the myth written in it.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The hero guarded the Fusang tree until it grew its hardest branch. To thank the hero for chasing off the monsters, the Fusang tree decided to gift the branch to the hero...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Look, that's the thank-you gift from the Fusang tree!
Thrilled, Yanyan grabs your hand and jogs toward the top of the High Tower. The FAC soldiers behind you shake their heads but quickly follow you.
The girl points at the dark crystalline branch at the top of the High Tower and runs right under it enthusiastically.
Instead of a branch, it appears more like a crystal with a fiery hue running within, emitting an ominous aura constantly.
Awakened by the Black Ring, the Corruptors start to stir. Startled, Yanyan drops her precious myth book to the ground.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yeeeee! Nonononono... This isn't how it's supposed to go! Something must have gone wrong. This is when the Fusang tree gives its branch to the hero...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I, I'm terribly sorry! I apologize! Please, calm down!
Seeing Yanyan panicking, the myth and the Fusang tree don't matter to you anymore. The most important thing now is to deal with these Corruptors in front of you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: So I just need to get the branch for you, right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Leave it to me. I know this tree well enough. It's right next door to where I live, after all.
You turn around to face the group of Corruptors and the blessed tree.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't think that just because you sound powerful in some myth you can do whatever you want. You're nothing more than an afterimage of the Black Ring.
